description: Writes a 5-digit ZIP onto a client's service address after the missing-zip plan's gates pass, as the cockpit's zip control does. The fix lands on the customer's BookingKoala profile through the business's write policy; a blocked policy answers outbound_stage_blocked and writes nothing. dryRun returns the plan without writing. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: fix_missing_zip
title: Fix a client's missing ZIP
